description: This file defines classes and data structures for representing and manipulating an Abstract Syntax Tree (AST) for a parser, including various node types such as expressions, statements, comments, and scope elements, used in a code parsing or compilation process.

classes.name: Comments
classes.description: Manages comments associated with parse nodes, including comments before, suffix, and after comments.

classes.name: ParseNode
classes.description: Base class for all AST nodes, providing common interface and JSON serialization.

classes.name: AccessorNode
classes.description: Represents property or array access in the AST.

classes.name: BlockNode
classes.description: Represents a block of statements, with scope management.

classes.name: LiteralNode
classes.description: Represents literal values such as strings, numbers.

classes.name: EndNode
classes.description: Represents the end token of list or block nodes, allowing comments to be attached at the end.

methods.name: ParseNode::Execute
methods.description: Executes the node within a given scope, returning a value.

methods.name: ParseNode::GetRange
methods.description: Returns the source code range covered by the node.

methods.name: ParseNode::MakeErrorDescribing
methods.description: Creates an error message related to this node.

methods.name: ParseNode::GetJSONNode
methods.description: Serializes the node to a JSON representation.

methods.name: Comments::comments
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the comments associated with the node.

methods.name: Comments::comments_mutable
methods.description: Returns a mutable pointer to the comments.

methods.name: ParseNode::BuildFromJSON
methods.description: Constructs a parse node from a JSON value.

methods.name: AccessorNode::Execute
methods.description: Evaluates the accessor node in a scope.
